messages:
sam: Kicking off release v2.14.0 now. Primary work: model routing changes + new batching config. Planning to ramp feature flag `llm-serving-v2` from 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over the next 45m.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: service=llm-inference image=redwood/llm:2.14.0 canary=1
jen: ack — monitoring dashboards up, added p95 latency + error-rate alarms to this thread. Gate criteria: error-rate < 0.5% and p95 < 300ms for 10m.
sam: starting initial 10% toggle now. Command: `/ff toggle llm-serving-v2 --percent 10 --actor sam --reason "canary ramp"`
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: llm-serving-v2 -> 10% (actor=sam) :white_check_mark:
alex: watching logs. small uptick in redis cache miss on canary but qps stable. tagging @maria
maria: looking at traces — one backend pod showing increased tail latency around KV cache warmup. I’ll restart that pod to test.
ops-bot: pod restart triggered: pod=llm-runtime-canary-3 by maria
jen: after 8m, metrics look steady. error-rate 0.12%, p95 210ms. recommend move to 50%.
sam: ok bumping to 50% now. `/ff toggle llm-serving-v2 --percent 50 --actor sam --reason "main ramp"`
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: llm-serving-v2 -> 50% (actor=sam) :rocket:
alex: noticed 2% increase in tail p99 on a subset of requests that include long context. Might be related to new kernel selection path.
maria: opening a short diagnostic snapshot. Can we hold at 50% for 12m and re-evaluate before 100%?
sam: yes hold for 12m. if p99 stays < 800ms and no errors go to 100%.
jen: setting a soft rollback timer at 30m — if error-rate > 0.6% auto-notify & candidate rollback.
(9m later) ops-bot: alert: p99 latency breached threshold (now 950ms) on region eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
alex: we should roll back to 10% and pin v2 to avoid full cutover until we patch kernel selector.
sam: rolling ff back to 10% and pinning version on routing to old-model by cohort for safety. `/ff toggle llm-serving-v2 --percent 10 --actor sam --reason "rollback: p99 spike"`
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: llm-serving-v2 -> 10% (actor=sam) :warning:
jen: confirmed rollback executed. alert suppressed. opening incident doc for kernel selector regression. assigning to infra/rtx team.
maria: collecting heap/kv stats from canary pods and saving traces to /s3/releases/v2.14.0/diagnostics/1709999999.tar.gz
alex: once infra patches, recommend a targeted canary with long-context traffic only (5% slice) to validate p99 before another ramp.
sam: agree. creating follow-up task: write release note about staged rollback and keep the change window open for another 2 hours. tagging @release-bot to publish draft.
release-bot: Draft release note created: "v2.14.0 cutover attempted; partial ramp to 50% triggered; rolled back to 10% due to p99 latency spike; patch in progress; next attempt planned after verification."
jen: moring postmortem plan: include prompt-set regression tests and rollout gating thresholds. For now, leaving flag at 10% and pausing automatic ramps.
sam: thanks all. will update when infra confirms fix. :thumbsup:
